Product Description

Indulge your senses with the WoodWick Medium Hourglass Candle in Vanilla Bean, crafted from a premium blend of soy and paraffin wax for a clean, consistent burn. Each aroma from WoodWick is custom blended using the finest ingredients, with the Vanilla Bean scent encapsulating the decadent blend of authentic vanilla bean and pure sugar cane. The iconic hourglass design, complemented by a wooden lid, is perfect for enhancing home decor - all while releasing a sophisticated, complex scent. Infused with patented Pluswick Innovation, the wood wick provides an intriguing glow & a distinctive crackling sound for an authentic fireplace experience.

    • John M.
      5 out of 5 stars
      One of the most satisfying and best scented candles out there!
      Reviewed in the United States on May 23, 2018
      Color: Vanilla BeanSize: 9.7oz
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Hello everyone, my name is John and this is my honest opinion on this product.

      You can buy candles almost anywhere. With so many retailers and brands, it is hard to choose which ones to buy. Maybe you like how one smells but it is too small. Maybe you like how one smells but it is too expensive. Well my fellow candle buyers, look no further than the Vanilla Bean Woodwick Jar Candle by Virginia Candle Company. Now I have to say this was a gift for a friend but I have owned many different Virginia Candle Company Candles in the past and I have loved them all. They are a conversation piece around the holidays and whenever family is over I always hear, "What is that smell? It smells great!" or "What is that crackling sound, is that the candle?" Now, for someone who has never bought one of these candles before, you may not know that these candles actually do make a nice crackling noise as they burn. Nothing dramatic enough to make the in-laws think there is a raging, crackling fire in the other room at thanksgiving, but not quiet enough that you have to tell everyone to quite down so you can admire that satisfying crackling and popping coming from the candle. It is honestly probably my favorite attribute to these candles. I just love that little crackle so much because of how satisfying it is .Anyway, you are probably tired of reading me talking about my obsession of crackling candles so here is what I can tell you about the smell. They have many great scents that are a pure delight to your nostrils. These candles give off a scent that is noticeable, but not too faint. The scent is strong, but not overpowering. Each of these candles smell just perfect. Now the reason I choose to review this specific scent of candle is because it is my favorite. It truly smells like vanilla bean, one of my favorite smells. Another notable attribute to these candles is the duration of burn time you have. Unlike your traditional wick, these candles burn longer and better. Plus they give a pretty little flame which looks a bit different from your generic candle. Anyway, thats all I really have to say.

      In conclusion, I would highly recommend this candle or any other candle by Virginia Candle Company. If you ask me how high these candles raise the bar, I would tell you that they are the bar. Nothing can beat them. But in all seriousness, I really do enjoy these candles and have given quite a few of them to my friends and family as gifts after they had asked me about them. These candles really are unique from any other because of the wick they use. If you are considering these candles, I really would encourage you to purchase one because you will not be disappointed with it. I will admit they are a bit pricey compared to your generic candle, (I mean seriously, 18 dollars for a candle) but these truly are a higher quality of candle compared to other brands. Anyway I hope this review was helpful, thanks for reading! ;)

      (Disclamer: I was not payed or sponsored in anyway to review this product. This is my honest and unbiased opinion on this product. Once again, I hope this review was helpful.)

    • Sir Charles Panther
      4 out of 5 stars
      Nice Product All Around, But Loud (for a candle, that is)
      Reviewed in the United States on September 7, 2007
      Color: Vanilla BeanSize: 9.7oz
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I bought this as a gift for my wife, who loves "schtinky" candles. I can't tolerate the really overly perfume-y candles, and was mighty happy when she lit this and we found that it has a very quiet, subtle yet deep vanilla aroma, just the way a scented candle should be, if you ask me. It's not quite as good as eating Breyer's vanilla ice cream, but it's not that far away either.

      The packaging is nice, and it was shipped very well. I like the lid for the candle jar, which becomes a very nice coaster once your candle is all gone up to candle heaven.

      The candle lights easily and burns well, not too fast, lasting for us a little longer than advertised. One thing I'll note, though: this is a noisy candle. That wood wick, for whatever reason, makes a lot of little popping and crackling sounds. This is not like a bowl of rice crispies or the crunch of shoes on a snowy sidewalk, but while most candles are for all intents and purposes silent, this one most certainly is not. It was only distractive for the first couple of times we burned the candle, just figuring out where that sneaky little background crackling was coming from. Once we identified it, it was no big deal, and soon enough we didn't even notice it anymore.

      Bottom line: This is a new adventure, however small and arguably trivial, in your domestic scented candle-burning journey. This is a nice product, and I recommend it.

    About this Item

    • Pluswick Innovation: Distinctive crackle for a multi-sensory experience
    • Premium Soy-Paraffin Blend: Ensures a clean, consistent burn

    Product Description

    Indulge your senses with the WoodWick Medium Hourglass Candle in Vanilla Bean, crafted from a premium blend of soy and paraffin wax for a clean, consistent burn. Each aroma from WoodWick is custom blended using the finest ingredients, with the Vanilla Bean scent encapsulating the decadent blend of authentic vanilla bean and pure sugar cane. The iconic hourglass design, complemented by a wooden lid, is perfect for enhancing home decor - all while releasing a sophisticated, complex scent. Infused with patented Pluswick Innovation, the wood wick provides an intriguing glow & a distinctive crackling sound for an authentic fireplace experience.
